name: Memphis Motion 孟菲斯节奏
description: 孟菲斯几何与粉青跳色的轻快视觉，适合活动、营销与创意内容
source: ClawHive-authored style card; no external vendor assets included.
pptFallback: 复杂 CSS 效果改为静态填充、渐变或烘焙背景，文字和形状保持原生

typography.title_stack: Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif
typography.title_stack_ppt: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif

behavior: 气质：俏皮、动感、乐观；视觉语汇：孟菲斯曲线、粉红与青绿跳色、大小不一的几何贴纸；装饰：squiggles, dots, arcs and offset geometric tokens；构图：varied grouping and scale; preserve an obvious reading path
taboos: 强调色一次只突出一个判断
coverStructure: playful title cluster with one directional shape
sectionStructure: chapters use rhythm changes rather than uniform panels
titleTreatment: bold rounded title with a short sticker label
decorativeLanguage: squiggles, dots, arcs and offset geometric tokens
bodyCompositionBias: varied grouping and scale; preserve an obvious reading path
